description: `Extract` and `Rewrite` operate on exactly one `tsconfig.json` per call. Reject ambiguous inputs (no `tsconfig.json` discoverable, multiple at the same level, pnpm workspace ambiguity) with a typed error explaining which file to point at.

requirements.description: Both Extract and Rewrite must operate on exactly one tsconfig.json per invocation. The scenario must implement discovery logic that identifies the applicable tsconfig.json from the provided project_path. project_path may be a project root directory or an explicit tsconfig.json file. Any ambiguous input must be rejected with a structured, typed error that identifies the ambiguity and instructs the caller which file path to specify. Ambiguous conditions include: no tsconfig.json discoverable in or above the path, multiple tsconfig.json files at the same directory level, and pnpm workspace roots where multiple packages each have a tsconfig.json.
requirements.title: Single tsconfig.json Resolution and Ambiguity Rejection

validation.notes: Test that a path containing a single tsconfig.json resolves correctly
Test that a path with no tsconfig.json returns a typed MISSING_TSCONFIG error with the searched path
Test that a path with two tsconfig.json files at the same level returns a typed AMBIGUOUS_TSCONFIG error listing both files
Test that a pnpm workspace root with multiple package-level tsconfig.json files returns a typed WORKSPACE_AMBIGUITY error
Test that the error message in all ambiguity cases includes the exact file path(s) involved and a recommendation
TCG-SINGLE-PROJECT: Extract call on a single-tsconfig fixture succeeds and returns a graph
Extract call on a fixture with no tsconfig.json returns a structured error, not a panic or untyped exception
Extract call on a multi-tsconfig fixture returns a structured AMBIGUOUS_TSCONFIG error with actionable message
CLI surfaces the typed error message directly to stderr without stack traces
Operator documentation includes examples of how to resolve each ambiguity error kind
No Extract or Rewrite call silently operates on the wrong tsconfig.json

title: Single-Project Resolution
